_doc: GET /api/packages answers one catalogue. valid cases decode; invalid ones must be refused for the reason given (a strict decoder: every key of rowKeys present, no other key except error, types as in README.md). error appears only in an administrator's catalogue, on a row whose last build failed. Decoded by server/internal/api (A7) and apps/web/src/lib/api/packages.ts (C5).
